title: pvBoundaryMeshQuality
body:
## pvBoundaryMeshQuality

Extracts the boundary faces of a volume mesh as polydata and, for each face, measures its relation to the volume cell it belongs to: DistanceFromCellCenterToFaceCenter, DistanceFromCellCenterToFacePlane (both in dataset length units) and AngleFaceNormalAndCellCenterToFaceCenterVector in degrees. Use it to inspect near-wall cell size and skewness, e.g. first-cell height on CFD walls. Input must be a volumetric grid (unstructured, structured, rectilinear or image data); use pvMeshQuality for whole-cell shape metrics.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- The output contains only boundary faces, so it cannot be combined cell by cell with the volume mesh without the original cell ids.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `BoundaryMeshQuality`. Identity: `filters/BoundaryMeshQuality`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

ParaView: This property specifies the input to the Boundary Mesh Quality filter. Accepted data: unstructured grids (vtkUnstructuredGridBase); image data (uniform rectilinear grids) (vtkImageData); rectilinear grids (vtkRectilinearGrid); curvilinear structured grids (vtkStructuredGrid); explicit structured grids (vtkExplicitStructuredGrid). | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":null,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkUnstructuredGridBase","vtkImageData","vtkRectilinearGrid","vtkStructuredGrid","vtkExplicitStructuredGrid"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `AngleFaceNormalAndCellCenterToFaceCenterVector` | This property indicates whether the angle of face's plane normal and cell center to face center vector will be computed. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `DistanceFromCellCenterToFaceCenter` | This property indicates whether the distance from cell center to face center will be computed. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `DistanceFromCellCenterToFacePlane` | This property indicates whether the distance from cell center to face's plane will be computed. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
